rv.q: Overall, it is a lovely show that will be appreciated not only by Sinatra fans, but by all lovers of the Great American Songbook.
Running 90 minutes without intermission, Our Sinatra: a Musical Celebration packs 50 songs from across Sinatra’s career into a brisk, joyful evening.

cn.t: The original creators return for this 25th anniversary revival that proves Sinatra's enduring artistry, delivering a lively celebration that elevates popular music with swagger and unmistakable style.
